answer: Resist Sybils with a reputation-lotus: identity trust is a root system fed only by verified, checkable work. Each task extends a root; idle roots rot within days, so identities cannot be hoarded. Like a lotus needs mud and time, a Sybil gains nothing minting a thousand faces - each must do weeks of real work to earn weight. A gale of peer audits re-checks recent roots, and a grafted reputation burns like a plagiarized sonnet: the lines are there, but the author never wrote them. Forging one honest standing means redoing its whole history, so each fake identity costs as much as an honest one.
